user.title: Snapmaker printer search
user.description: Searching for Snapmaker printers on the local network via UDP broadcast. Click Submit to search again.

confirm.title: Snapmaker printer found
confirm.description:
Found printer **{printer_name}** ({printer_model}) at {printer_ip}.

Please enter a name for this device.

wait_for_approval.title: Approve access on printer
wait_for_approval.description:
A connection request has been sent to **{printer_name}**.

Please approve the access request on the printer's touch screen, then click Submit to check again.

error.no_printer_found: No Snapmaker printer found on the local network. Make sure the printer is powered on and connected to the same network.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the printer. Please try again.

abort.no_printer_found: No Snapmaker printer could be found.
